notes.title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story - FULL RELEASE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/332831e19a5fcd88843fb5fb83e66d871ad4d387.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi all![/p][p]We are thrilled to share that we've finished the Early Access phase of our erotic dating simulator, [i][b]Quickie: A Love Hotel Story[/b][/i], and have officially released version v1.0! Whether you've been with us since the beginning or are just starting your journey, we hope you enjoy all that [i][b]Quickie: A Love Hotel Story[/b][/i] has in store ♥[/p][h3]
V1.0 CHANGELOG[/h3][p]Full changelog patch notes can be found in this [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1517850/view/499449376025872529"]Steam post here[/url] and the in-game changelog notes.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517850/Quickie_A_Love_Hotel_Story/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]A WORD FROM THE DEVELOPER[/h3][p]It’s been quite a long journey, but we’ve finally reached the full release for [i]Quickie: A Love Hotel Story[/i]. And what a journey it has been: from small Quickie Flash games on Newgrounds to a full fledged dating-sim on Steam! We had no idea what we were in for, or what we were even doing at times… but we were determined to make it to the end. We’ve faced many challenges and burnt out more times than we’d like to admit, but we’ve gained many valuable lessons along the way - lessons that we hope will make us better developers in the future! [b]With lots of love from the two of us, Lykonis and Fibs, we sincerely hope you enjoy Quickie: A Love Hotel Story![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]WHAT’S NEXT?[/h3][p]We've poured all our efforts into finally bringing [i]Quickie: A Love Hotel Story[/i] to completion! As we move ahead, we'll be keeping a close eye on the launch to ensure everything runs smoothly for our players, and we'll release patches as necessary to fix any problems.[b] [/b]Once we're confident everything is stable, our small team of two will take a much needed break to recharge and plan what’s next for us at Oppai Games. We're looking forward to sharing more about our future plans as soon as we're ready ♥[/p][p][/p][h3]THANK YOU![/h3][p]A huge thank you goes out to the incredible talent that helped us along the way: the voice actors, writers, and translators who helped bring this game to fruition! [/p][p][/p][p]Of course, our journey wouldn't have been possible without the constant support from each of you and our Patrons on Patreon, who enabled us to start on this crazy journey! Your comments and feedback has always driven us to finally achieve this milestone, and now with mixed emotions… [i]we finally close the final chapter of this Love Hotel Story.[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p]♥[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] v1.0 OUT NOW!

We hope this will make the newer hotels feel less like a step back as you unlock and build new hotels. [/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]BUILD  v0.40 HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]♥ Quickie Hotel Manager[/b][/h3][p]We’ve focused most of our energy this build in trying to make Quickie Hotel Manager a better experience overall, without changing too much of what players are already familiar with. notes.title: [PATCH] 'My One and Only' Achievement Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

We’ve been seeing some discussions arising around one of our recently added achievements,[b] ‘My One and Only’[/b], and noticed it’s been causing a bit of a stir. 

We initially added the new achievements to reward players who explored all the options with [b]‘Casanova’[/b], but also wanted to recognize the rare player who remained loyal to their favourite waifu with [b]‘My One and Only’[/b].

We didn't anticipate that adding this achievement later in the Early Access development might have upset some players. Our intention was solely to add achievements for enjoyment and to encourage diverse playing styles. But we hadn't realized how important collecting all the achievements was for many of you.

[b]As a result, we’ve updated the game (v0.39.2) with a new way to achieve the last achievement WITHOUT needing to start a new game.[/b]

[b]How To Get the ‘My One and Only’ Achievement:[/b]
[list]
[*] End the game with ONE love interest at 5 hearts (Strong Bond). 
[*] OR end the game and break up with ALL the other love interests you have created a Strong Bond with.
[/list]
[b]Concerning a Harem Ending:[/b]
I know many of you were hoping to see this feature, but unfortunately, it wasn't part of our original plan for the game. It was an artistic decision we made for Quickie some time ago, and while we understand it might be disappointing for some, we hope you can respect our choice :) 

Thank you all for the ongoing support, love, and feedback! We look forward to releasing our final update with all missing assets, polish and some much-needed tweaks and balancing for the hotel manager game. You can expect this sometime in Q2. 

If you've already unlocked the [b]‘My One and Only’[/b] achievement before this update, or if you aim to get it soon, who is your One and Only? Let us know in the comments! ♥
